hints: Run: Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path ./candidate.ps1 | Select-Object RuleName, Severity, Line, Message > pssa.txt -- then draft ci-step.yml and notes.md.
ci-step.yml needs to name PSScriptAnalyzer and fail/exit the build on Error/Warning; notes.md needs to name ShellCheck as the bash equivalent.

If PSScriptAnalyzer isn't installed: Install-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -Scope CurrentUser -Force (needs PSGallery egress; offline fallback is Save-Module from a machine that has it). ci-step.yml example:
- name: PSScriptAnalyzer
  run: |
    $results = Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse
    if ($results | Where-Object { $_.Severity -in 'Error', 'Warning' }) {
      Write-Error "PSScriptAnalyzer found findings -- failing the build"
      exit 1
    }
notes.md: "PSScriptAnalyzer is the PowerShell equivalent of ShellCheck."
